findings.summary:
isKept accepts, inside a block that also holds approved lines, a piece equal to a whole current_html text (e.g. `

Liquidez ágil Tasa 12%

` passes if the current slide had a «Tasa 12%» block), although the prompt asks for kept texts «en su propio bloque». Only previously existing slide copy can pass this way, never invented or reference text.
findings.action: Optional: require a kept piece to fill its whole HTML block.

findings.summary: leaveHtmlDesignDraft and clearError are unit-tested, but the conversation-mode onClick (leave + onClose clearing localError and work.error) has no automated test (no DOM test infra) and was not driven in a browser.
findings.action: Manual check after Vite reload: click «Salir conservando el último borrador guardado»; the red error and the yellow «El documento cambió…» banner disappear and «Aplicar al diseño actual» can be sent again.
